children.title: Heredity Thresholds in Prebiotic Chemical Systems

detail.title: Heredity Thresholds in Prebiotic Chemical Systems
detail.summary: This revision synthesizes findings on error thresholds, copying fidelity, and compositional stability, distinguishing between passive persistence and the emergence of Darwinian evolution in non-templated chemical networks.
detail.reason: Incorporating evidence on the emergence of natural selection in prebiotic networks and the distinction between heritability and genetic templating.
